candidates.title: MLX engine: weights are unwired ~2 s after each request on macOS 27, so the first request after idle pages them back in
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  On the MLX engine, a loaded model's weights stay wired only while a request is running. About two seconds after each request macOS releases them, and they become ordinary pageable memory. On a machine under any memory pressure they are then compressed or swapped, and the next request waits for them to come back.
